key: FLORINIA: You return. Very well.
en: FLORINIA: You return. Very well.
ja: フロリニア: 戻ってきたか。よろしい。

key: FLORINIA: Let's begin the next trial.
en: FLORINIA: Let's begin the next trial.
ja: フロリニア: 次の試練を始めよう。

key: FLORINIA: Welcome, \PN.
en: FLORINIA: Welcome, \PN.
ja: フロリニア: ようこそ、\PN。

key: Your assistance in Meteor-related affairs is appreciated.
en: Your assistance in Meteor-related affairs is appreciated.
ja: メテオ団関連の件での協力には感謝している。

key: However, that alone fails to merit the appropriation of a Badge.
en: However, that alone fails to merit the appropriation of a Badge.
ja: しかし、それだけではバッジを与えるに値しない。

key: In order to determine eligibility for Badge-ownership, further trial is required.
en: In order to determine eligibility for Badge-ownership, further trial is required.
ja: バッジ所有の資格を見極めるには、さらなる試練が必要である。

key: Do not mistake the impartial application of these tests as unthankfulness.
en: Do not mistake the impartial application of these tests as unthankfulness.
ja: この試験を公平に適用することを、感謝の欠如と誤解しないように。

key: It is simply procedure.
en: It is simply procedure.
ja: 単なる手続きに過ぎない。

key: Accordingly, let us begin.
en: Accordingly, let us begin.
ja: それでは、始めよう。

key: FLORINIA: Students, please take notes on standard battling procedure.
en: FLORINIA: Students, please take notes on standard battling procedure.
ja: フロリニア: 生徒諸君、標準的なバトル手順についてメモを取るように。

key: The demonstration will commence.
en: The demonstration will commence.
ja: これより実演を開始する。

key: Hypothesis: Subject displays insufficient data for conclusive success.
en: Hypothesis: Subject displays insufficient data for conclusive success.
ja: 仮説: 被験者は、確実な成功に足るデータを示していない。

key: Expected outcome: Failure.
en: Expected outcome: Failure.
ja: 予測される結果: 失敗。

key: ...Very well.
en: ...Very well.
ja: ……了解した

key: FLORINIA: Challenger remains due to receive Canopy Badge.
en: FLORINIA: Challenger remains due to receive Canopy Badge.
ja: フロリニア: 挑戦者には、キャノピーバッジを授与すべきである。

key: \PN received the Canopy Badge!
en: \PN received the Canopy Badge!
ja: \PNはキャノピーバッジを受け取った!

key: FLORINIA: The Canopy Badge encourages proper behavior among Pokémon up to level 35.
en: FLORINIA: The Canopy Badge encourages proper behavior among Pokémon up to level 35.
ja: フロリニア: キャノピーバッジは、レベル35までのポケモンに正しい行動を促す。

key: Additionally, as per custom, accept this TM.
en: Additionally, as per custom, accept this TM.
ja: また、慣例に従い、このわざマシンを受け取るように。

key: FLORINIA: Nature Power varies based on the terrain and Field Effects in which it is used.
en: FLORINIA: Nature Power varies based on the terrain and Field Effects in which it is used.
ja: フロリニア: しぜんのちからは、使用される地形とフィールド効果によって変化する。

key: To use it effectively, one must exercise proper knowledge and understanding-- a staple of an effective Trainer.
en: To use it effectively, one must exercise proper knowledge and understanding-- a staple of an effective Trainer.
ja: 効果的に使うには、正しい知識と理解が必要である――優秀なトレーナーに欠かせない要素だ。

key: Use it wisely.
en: Use it wisely.
ja: 賢く使うように。

key: AMARIA: Excuse me~
en: AMARIA: Excuse me~
ja: アマリア: ちょっとごめーん～

key: Hope I'm not interrupting!
en: Hope I'm not interrupting!
ja: 邪魔じゃないといいけど!

key: FLORINIA: The previous trial was just concluded.
en: FLORINIA: The previous trial was just concluded.
ja: フロリニア: 先ほどの試練が、たった今終わったところだ。

key: Report.
en: Report.
ja: 報告を。

key: AMARIA: Apparently Borealis was seen up around the Beryl Ward recently.
en: AMARIA: Apparently Borealis was seen up around the Beryl Ward recently.
ja: アマリア: 最近、ベリルワード辺りでボレアリスが目撃されたみたい。

key: If he's there, there's a chance Victoria is too.
en: If he's there, there's a chance Victoria is too.
ja: 彼がそこにいるなら、ヴィクトリアもいる可能性がある。

key: FLORINIA: ...Understood.
en: FLORINIA: ...Understood.
ja: フロリニア: ……了解した。

key: \PN, as has been mentioned already, the Beryl and Jasper Wards presently remain under strict lockdown due to flora-incited destruction a la the Obsidia Park.
en: \PN, as has been mentioned already, the Beryl and Jasper Wards presently remain under strict lockdown due to flora-incited destruction a la the Obsidia Park.
ja: \PN、すでに述べた通り、ベリルワードとジャスパーワードは現在、オブシディア公園のような植物による破壊が原因で厳重に封鎖されている。

key: Whereas we caught Obsidia in a budding state, property and economic damage in those wards has been extensive.
en: Whereas we caught Obsidia in a budding state, property and economic damage in those wards has been extensive.
ja: オブシディアでは初期段階で食い止められたが、あの二つのワードでは、財産的・経済的な被害が甚大である。

key: If Borealis exists there as well, it is highly likely a correlation exists.
en: If Borealis exists there as well, it is highly likely a correlation exists.
ja: そこにもボレアリスが存在するのであれば、関連性がある可能性は極めて高い。

key: Being that you alone have had the experience of successfully terminating the previous machine, as well as witnessing Borealis, you are an ideal candidate for an excursion into the Beryl Ward.
en: Being that you alone have had the experience of successfully terminating the previous machine, as well as witnessing Borealis, you are an ideal candidate for an excursion into the Beryl Ward.
ja: 前回の機械を単独で無力化した経験があり、なおかつボレアリスを目撃しているのは君だけだ。ゆえに、ベリルワードへの調査に最も適した人材と言える。

key: Incidentally, this speaker has created another application that may be of service to you.
en: Incidentally, this speaker has created another application that may be of service to you.
ja: ちなみに、この発言者は、君の役に立つかもしれない別のアプリケーションを作成した。

key: \PN received the PULSE Dex!
en: \PN received the PULSE Dex!
ja: \PNはPULSE図鑑を受け取った!

key: FLORINIA: This will install to your Pokégear, and will read data output from the machine we encountered before.
en: FLORINIA: This will install to your Pokégear, and will read data output from the machine we encountered before.
ja: フロリニア: これはポケギアにインストールされ、先ほど遭遇した機械から出力されたデータを読み取る。

key: Intelligence has revealed the machine is called the Pokémon Ultimation Link System Exaggeratta, or simply "PULSE" for short.
en: Intelligence has revealed the machine is called the Pokémon Ultimation Link System Exaggeratta, or simply "PULSE" for short.
ja: 調査により、あの機械は「ポケモン究極リンクシステム・エクサジェレッタ」、略して「PULSE」と呼ばれることが判明した。

key: This speaker has already entered the data obtained regarding the previously-engaged Tangrowth, but any future subjects must be added separately.
en: This speaker has already entered the data obtained regarding the previously-engaged Tangrowth, but any future subjects must be added separately.
ja: この発言者は、先に交戦したモジャンボに関するデータをすでに入力済みだが、今後の対象については別途追加が必要である。

key: Analogous to the Field Notes app, the PULSE Dex is capable of alerting you when within the presence of a machine whose data has been recorded.
en: Analogous to the Field Notes app, the PULSE Dex is capable of alerting you when within the presence of a machine whose data has been recorded.
ja: フィールドノートアプリと同様、PULSE図鑑はデータが記録済みの機械の近くにいるとき、通知することができる。

key: If any inquiries about the afflicted Pokémon emerge, press D in battle to access its associated data.
en: If any inquiries about the afflicted Pokémon emerge, press D in battle to access its associated data.
ja: 汚染されたポケモンについて疑問が生じた場合、バトル中にDキーを押せば関連データにアクセスできる。

key: It may be possible to find data print-outs for each machine in an area near their application, so remain watchful.
en: It may be possible to find data print-outs for each machine in an area near their application, so remain watchful.
ja: 各機械についてのデータの出力紙が、その使用場所付近で見つかることがあるので、注意を怠らないように。

key: AMARIA: I'll keep searching the other wards as well!
en: AMARIA: I'll keep searching the other wards as well!
ja: アマリア: あたし、他のワードも探し続けるね!

key: It seems like with Team Meteor snooping about to this extent, we've got a lot of work to do!
en: It seems like with Team Meteor snooping about to this extent, we've got a lot of work to do!
ja: メテオ団がここまでこそこそ動き回ってるみたいだし、やることがいっぱいありそう!

key: STUDENT: Wait, is that Amaria?
en: STUDENT: Wait, is that Amaria?
ja: 生徒: 待って、あれってアマリア?

key: The Water Gym Leader?
en: The Water Gym Leader?
ja: みずタイプのジムリーダーの?

key: AMARIA: Um, hi!?
en: AMARIA: Um, hi!?
ja: アマリア: え、あ、どうも!?

key: STUDENT: I heard she graduated from here, but I didn't think we'd get to meet her!
en: STUDENT: I heard she graduated from here, but I didn't think we'd get to meet her!
ja: 生徒: ここの卒業生だって聞いてたけど、まさか会えるとは思わなかった!

key: STUDENT: Amy, give us a battle demo!
en: STUDENT: Amy, give us a battle demo!
ja: 生徒: エイミー、バトルのデモやってよ!

key: AMARIA: Guys, this isn't really the time...
en: AMARIA: Guys, this isn't really the time...
ja: アマリア: みんな、今そういうタイミングじゃ……

key: STUDENT: We've heard so much about you!
en: STUDENT: We've heard so much about you!
ja: 生徒: あなたのこと、いっぱい聞いてるよ!

key: STUDENT: Just one battle!
en: STUDENT: Just one battle!
ja: 生徒: 一戦だけでいいから!

key: AMARIA: Oh, dear...
en: AMARIA: Oh, dear...
ja: アマリア: ちょっと……

key: FLORINIA: We will deal with this and then make preparations for your passage to Jasper, through which you may reach Beryl.
en: FLORINIA: We will deal with this and then make preparations for your passage to Jasper, through which you may reach Beryl.
ja: フロリニア: これに対応した後、ジャスパーへの通行の準備をしよう。そこを通ればベリルに到達できる。

key: The path can be found north of Peridot.
en: The path can be found north of Peridot.
ja: その道はペリドットの北にある。

key: One might wish you good luck, however, luck is merely an illusory essentialization of statistics, and is neither inherently good nor bad.
en: One might wish you good luck, however, luck is merely an illusory essentialization of statistics, and is neither inherently good nor bad.
ja: 幸運を、と言いたいところだが、運とは統計を幻想的に本質化したものに過ぎず、本質的に良いも悪いもない。

key: Regardless, farewell.
en: Regardless, farewell.
ja: とはいえ、さらばだ。

key: FLORINIA: Farewell.
en: FLORINIA: Farewell.
ja: フロリニア: さらばだ。

key: BENNETT: ...Which is why it's important to have a thorough understanding of checks and threats to common win conditions.
en: BENNETT: ...Which is why it's important to have a thorough understanding of checks and threats to common win conditions.
ja: ……だからこそ、一般的な勝ち筋に対するチェックと脅威を、徹底的に理解することが重要なんだ。

key: Many beginning Trainers favor a hyper-offensive style focusing solely on offensive moves and type coverage,
en: Many beginning Trainers favor a hyper-offensive style focusing solely on offensive moves and type coverage,
ja: 多くの初心者トレーナーは、攻撃技とタイプ相性の網羅だけに焦点を当てた、超攻撃型のスタイルを好む傾向にある。

key: But this approach to team-building is focused on the naive generalization of types themselves as the primary determinants of battle.
en: But this approach to team-building is focused on the naive generalization of types themselves as the primary determinants of battle.
ja: だが、このパーティ構築のアプローチは、タイプそのものをバトルの主要な決定要因とする、素朴な一般化に偏りすぎている。

key: We are not battling against types; we are battling against Pokémon.
en: We are not battling against types; we are battling against Pokémon.
ja: 僕たちが戦っているのはタイプじゃない。ポケモンそのものと戦っているんだ。

key: Putting the focus on win conditions and countering specific checks is the reason that even mono and duo themed teams are able to prevail.
en: Putting the focus on win conditions and countering specific checks is the reason that even mono and duo themed teams are able to prevail.
ja: 勝ち筋と、特定の対策への対応に焦点を当てるからこそ、単タイプや2タイプ縛りのパーティでも勝ち抜けるんだ。

key: Before we move on, are there any questions?
en: Before we move on, are there any questions?
ja: 先に進む前に、何か質問はあるかな?

key: BOY: Yeah, so, are you like, gonna be a real teacher here now, or what?
en: BOY: Yeah, so, are you like, gonna be a real teacher here now, or what?
ja: 少年: えっと、それで、あなたってこれから本当にここの先生になるんですか、それとも何なんですか?

key: BENNETT: This is just a one time guest lecture.
en: BENNETT: This is just a one time guest lecture.
ja: ベネット: これは一回限りのゲスト講義だよ。

key: Your headmistress thought some of you might be interested in hearing from a member of the Elite Four.
en: Your headmistress thought some of you might be interested in hearing from a member of the Elite Four.
ja: 君たちの校長先生が、四天王のメンバーの話に興味を持つ生徒がいるかもしれないと思ってね。

key: Personally, though, I feel I'm just as much a student as any of you.
en: Personally, though, I feel I'm just as much a student as any of you.
ja: 個人的には、僕も君たちと同じくらい、まだ学ぶ身だと思ってるよ。

key: I'm sure there are things you all can teach me as well.
en: I'm sure there are things you all can teach me as well.
ja: きっと、君たちが僕に教えてくれることもあるはずだ。

key: GIRL: Hey, yeah, I have a question!
en: GIRL: Hey, yeah, I have a question!
ja: 少女: あ、はい、質問あります!

key: So are you and Laura dating or what?
en: So are you and Laura dating or what?
ja: それで、あなたとローラって付き合ってるんですか、それとも何なんですか?

key: BENNETT: What?
en: BENNETT: What?
ja: ベネット: え?

key: No, it's not like that.
en: No, it's not like that.
ja: いや、そういうんじゃないよ。

key: GIRL: Okay, but you two are together like all the time, right?
en: GIRL: Okay, but you two are together like all the time, right?
ja: 少女: でも、いつも二人一緒にいますよね?

key: You said you were meeting her after this too, right?
en: You said you were meeting her after this too, right?
ja: この後も会うって言ってましたよね?

key: BENNETT: Yes, we're just meeting for dinner; that's all.
en: BENNETT: Yes, we're just meeting for dinner; that's all.
ja: ベネット: ああ、夕食を一緒に食べるだけだよ、それだけさ。

key: GIRL: At, like, a restraurant?
en: GIRL: At, like, a restraurant?
ja: 少女: それって、レストランで?

key: BENNETT: Yes?
en: BENNETT: Yes?
ja: ベネット: ああ?

key: GIRL: With just her?
en: GIRL: With just her?
ja: 少女: 彼女と二人だけで?

key: BENNETT: Yes...?
en: BENNETT: Yes...?
ja: ベネット: そうだけど……?

key: GIRL: So it's a date.
en: GIRL: So it's a date.
ja: 少女: それってデートじゃないですか。

key: BENNETT: ...No, it's--
en: BENNETT: ...No, it's--
ja: ベネット: ……いや、それは――

key: GIRL: So you're dating.
en: GIRL: So you're dating.
ja: 少女: つまり、付き合ってるんですね。

key: BENNETT: No, we--
en: BENNETT: No, we--
ja: ベネット: 違う、僕たちは――

key: GIRL: You're meeting for dinner at a restaurant, alone, with a girl, so it's a date, so you're dating.
en: GIRL: You're meeting for dinner at a restaurant, alone, with a girl, so it's a date, so you're dating.
ja: 少女: レストランで、女の子と二人きりで夕食を食べる。それってデートで、つまり付き合ってるってことです。

key: Like, that's the word; that's what those words mean.
en: Like, that's the word; that's what those words mean.
ja: だって、そういう言葉ってそういう意味じゃないですか。

key: You're dating.
en: You're dating.
ja: 付き合ってるんですよ。

key: BENNETT: ...
en: BENNETT: ...
ja: ベネット: ……

key: Are there any questions about the lecture?
en: Are there any questions about the lecture?
ja: 講義について、何か質問は?

key: BENNETT: ...Right.
en: BENNETT: ...Right.
ja: ベネット: ……よし。

key: Well, practical application is always better than theory anyway.
en: Well, practical application is always better than theory anyway.
ja: まあ、実践は常に理論に勝るものだしね。

key: To that end, I've brought in a friend to help demonstrate.
en: To that end, I've brought in a friend to help demonstrate.
ja: そこで、実演を手伝ってもらうために友人を連れてきたんだ。

key: Please come in.
en: Please come in.
ja: どうぞ、入ってきて。

key: STUDENT: Wait, so we get to see a member of the Elite Four AND the Champion???
en: STUDENT: Wait, so we get to see a member of the Elite Four AND the Champion???
ja: 生徒: 待って、四天王とチャンピオン、両方見られるってこと???

key: BENNETT: Not only that,
en: BENNETT: Not only that,
ja: ベネット: それだけじゃないよ、

key: But after our fight, we'll also be accepting volunteers, and will fight against several of you ourselves.
en: But after our fight, we'll also be accepting volunteers, and will fight against several of you ourselves.
ja: 僕たちの試合の後、志願者を募って、僕たち自身が何人かと戦うつもりだ。

key: STUDENT: What?!
en: STUDENT: What?!
ja: 生徒: え、マジで?!

key: There's no way we'd win against either of you!
en: There's no way we'd win against either of you!
ja: どっちに対しても、勝てるわけないじゃん!

key: BENNETT: The point is not to win; but to learn.
en: BENNETT: The point is not to win; but to learn.
ja: ベネット: 大事なのは勝つことじゃなく、学ぶことだよ。

key: BENNETT: I'm still doing that myself.
en: BENNETT: I'm still doing that myself.
ja: ベネット: 僕自身、今もそうしているところさ。

key: \PN, shall we have another go?
en: \PN, shall we have another go?
ja: \PN、もう一戦いこうか?
